claims.label: supported
claims.claim_summary: Reversible context management provides resource savings on noisy tasks but depends on workload
claims.claim_text_verbatim: These observations demonstrate substantial resource savings in noisy tool-use trajectories and identify workload dependence as a central consideration for reversible context management.

evidence_spans.source_text: Cumulative input decreases by 50%, and input plus completion tokens decrease by 50%. The estimated cost is approximately 67–71% lower, even after reported cache usage is included.
Planroom yields no context or cost saving: the method ends with 6% more prompt tokens (283,105 versus 265,965) and uses less than 1% more total tokens (68,136,934 versus 67,669,624).
